verdict.rationale: Statsig documents a Console API, a CRUD API that performs every console.statsig.com action without the web UI. It publishes a public, versioned OpenAPI 3.0 spec with a no-breaking-changes guarantee and offers in-page live 'Try it' request runners. A separate HTTP API covers evaluating gates and experiments and logging events. The probe's 404s on the docs-domain OpenAPI paths do not contradict this, because the spec is published at the versioned api.statsig.com path. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product end-to-end through the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Console API is the CRUD API for performing the actions available on console.statsig.com without using the web UI.
Statsig keeps the OpenAPI spec for this API version up-to-date.
Statsig guarantees that each version won't break existing usage
Overview of the Statsig HTTP API for retrieving feature gate, experiment, and dynamic config values and logging events directly without an SDK.
